title: Hall voltage vs B (field from the Halbach array)
description: With field coupling on, the Hall strip sits in the Halbach array's peak field. Hold the strip current fixed and step the array from 4 to 24 segments: V_H = I·B·R_H / t, so V_H against B is a line through the origin with slope I·R_H/t. Simulated, not metrology.
